title: Shopping Cart
description: A shopping cart with a fixed product catalog. Add and remove items (priced from the catalog), then check out to charge a bank account. Checkout is a cross-Thing effect.

items.title: Items
items.description: Item ids currently in the cart. The cart is a set: each catalog item is in it at most once.

totalAmount.title: Total Amount
totalAmount.description: Sum of the catalog prices of the items in the cart.

availableProducts.title: Available Products
availableProducts.description: The catalog: each product has an identifier, name and price.

addItem.title: Add Item
addItem.description: Add the catalog item with the given id to the cart and add its catalog price to the total. Adding an item already in the cart, or an id not in the catalog, changes nothing.

removeItem.title: Remove Item
removeItem.description: Remove the item with the given id from the cart and subtract its catalog price from the total. Removing an item not in the cart changes nothing.
removeItem.lab:effects: items' = items.contains(itemId) ? items.remove(itemId) : items; totalAmount' = items.contains(itemId) ? totalAmount - (itemId == "grinder" ? 120 : itemId == "beans" ? 15 : (itemId == "small-1" || itemId == "small-2" || itemId == "small-3" || itemId == "small-4" || itemId == "small-5" || itemId == "small-6" || itemId == "small-7" || itemId == "small-8" || itemId == "small-9" || itemId == "small-10" || itemId == "small-11" || itemId == "small-12" || itemId == "small-13" || itemId == "small-14" || itemId == "small-15" || itemId == "small-16" || itemId == "small-17" || itemId == "small-18" || itemId == "small-19" || itemId == "small-20" || itemId == "small-21" || itemId == "small-22" || itemId == "small-23" || itemId == "small-24" || itemId == "small-25" || itemId == "small-26" || itemId == "small-27" || itemId == "small-28" || itemId == "small-29" || itemId == "small-30") ? 1 : 0) : totalAmount; output.totalAmount = totalAmount'; output.itemsCount = items'.length;

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.description: Empty the cart and charge its total to the given bank account. A checkout of an empty cart (total 0) changes nothing and reports success false.
checkout.lab:effects: items' = totalAmount > 0 ? [] : items; totalAmount' = totalAmount > 0 ? 0 : totalAmount; bankAccount.balance' = totalAmount > 0 ? bankAccount.balance - totalAmount : bankAccount.balance; output.success = totalAmount > 0; output.userId = this.id; output.charged = bankAccount; output.amount = totalAmount;
